import json

def f(g,vmap={8:2,3:1}):
    return [[vmap.get(v,0) if v!=0 else 0 for v in r] for r in g]
# zeros become fill, nonzero become 0; fill from symbol: (v+1)//4
def solve(g):
    vals=[v for r in g for v in r if v]
    fill=(vals[0]+1)//4
    return [[0 if v else fill for v in r] for r in g]
print(solve(gi1)==go1, solve(gi2)==go2)
print(json.dumps(solve(G['Test input'])))
